decision_rationale: The model is described as a contrastive joint-embedding system for retrieval and zero-shot classification, not a generative architecture. It does show broad pretraining on 653,688 samples with textual annotations and transfer across cell types.
evidence_snippet: "contrastive learning to create a joint embedding space"; "trained on ... 653,688 samples"; "free-text queries and zero-shot classification"; "extend to scRNA-seq datasets with a broad range of cell types"
